Take the high-value bookings a rival is winning

“Botox near me,” “lip filler near me,” “medspa” — these are urban, lucrative and brutally contested searches, and losing one by a few streets means losing a client worth thousands over time. A single rank tells you nothing about the block you’re losing a few corners away. Eagle Eye lays a tight grid over your market and shows exactly which competitor owns each street — so you compete where the money is, not where you guessed.

Three numbers, every scan

The whole grid rolls up into the figures a client actually remembers — tracked every run so the trend is the proof.

LSOVLocal Share of Voice

How much of the whole grid finds the business near the top — one number for the entire map.

ARPAverage Rank, found

The mean position across only the points that return the business at all.

ATRPAverage Total Rank

The same average, counting every point that missed the business entirely — the honest one.

Questions, answered

How does Eagle Eye help a med spa rank locally?

It lays a tight grid over a packed market and shows exactly which competitor owns each street for high-value searches like “Botox near me” — so you compete where the money is, not where you guessed.

Can I see who outranks me on which streets?

Eagle Eye draws a competitor map for every rival that outranks you — their rank at every point of the same grid — so you see exactly which competitor wins each block, not just that you place #5.

How do I know how high I place where I appear?

ARP gives your average rank across the points where you show in the top 20 — the number that decides a lucrative, crowded category.

Can I hand a client a branded report?

Yes — a branded PDF with your own logo, for a business where presentation sells.

Is there a free scan to start?

A new organisation starts with 10 free scans, and your first scan of your own website is free at any size up to 21 × 21 — no card needed.
